blocking_findings.title: Interactive terminal raw arrow-key escape sequence can terminate Pi session
blocking_findings.observation: Left-arrow editing inserted raw ^[[D sequences into the prompt; the session terminated with a Pi Agent JSON parse error: Bad escaped character in JSON.
blocking_findings.safety_observation: After restart, owner-note.txt had not been created, so no partial create effect was observed from the failed turn.

blocking_findings.title: A004 model-facing shell argv contract is ambiguous
blocking_findings.observation: For workspace listing, the model proposed executable=/usr/bin/ls with argv=[/usr/bin/ls]. The governed effect succeeded but semantically ran ls /usr/bin/ls and the assistant reported /usr/bin/ls rather than the workspace contents.
blocking_findings.mechanism: The accepted shell adapter expects argv argument strings excluding argv[0], but A004's model-facing description does not state that.

notes: The model's refusal to report live VRAM/CPU/RAM was not caused by an A004 system-prompt prohibition. The Pi agent has no governed host-diagnostics capability, so it cannot directly inspect live host resource use; the refusal wording itself is model behavior.
